hollis.note: Against Tamsin in s1-06 you moved on every one of your turns and finished at 0.47, below an even split. When the other side keeps countering, repeat your last offer once before conceding again; you still had actions to spare.

marlow.note: In s1-08 your last offer gave Juno a tea (worth 4 to you) for a silk (worth 2 to you), and you ended at 0.47. When you have to move, give up what is worth least to you, never what is worth most.
